name: Horrorfied
blurb: A horror convention at K2 Crawley with celebrity guests, cosplay and horror merch.

editions.evidence: Homepage text: 'Due to unforeseen circumstances Horrorfied 3 will now take place on new dates of 13th and 14th March 2027... announcing our first guests very soon!'

notes: Horrorfied 3 was originally set for 28-29 March 2026 (per the page's own meta description) but has been postponed to 13-14 March 2027; the site says guests and tickets are still to be announced.
